Yes. You can export your transactions as a CSV or a JSON file. CSV opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers. JSON is the better choice if you want to use your data in other apps or tools.

Exports are fast. An export of 10,000 transactions finishes in under 2 minutes.

Exporting is included on the free plan, so you don't need to upgrade to get your own records. You can use it to switch budgeting tools, back up your history, or analyze your spending in a spreadsheet.
